{{Quote|We wanted to give the Senator an N-1 escort wherever she went, but... we just couldn't keep up with the Royal Yacht, especially with Padmé at the controls.|Ric Olié|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
The '''H-type Nubian yacht''' was a sleek, rocket-shaped [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] created by the [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubian Design Collective]], and customized by the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]] for the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Nabooyacht-NEGVV.png|thumb|left|180px|A Nubian yacht.]]
The vessel was unarmed in accordance with the peaceful culture of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The yacht only required a small crew and Padmé could pilot the ship on her own from the cockpit in the central area of the yacht's upper section. Below the cockpit were maintenance consoles, the Class 0.9 Nubian 150 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] core and stores to contain supplies and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]].

The lower and upper levels were connected by a turbolift platform, situated before the lounge and crew bunks on the upper level. At the front section of the lower level was Padmé's bedroom which could serve as a portable throne room. The ship featured a powerful shield system, an array of electronic countermeasures, a slim, narrow profile and sheltered engines giving a small sensor signature for evading pursuits. It also featured a breakaway [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].

==History==
Though originally constructed for the Royal House, the yacht was not assigned to a member of Naboo's royalty. Instead, it was given to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] after a failed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] resulted in the destruction of her [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|Naboo Royal Cruiser]].

[[File:NabooYachtLanding-AotC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Naboo Yacht lands in a docking bay on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]
Naboo Yachts were the smallest non-fighter craft in the Theed Hangars, and they were primarily employed as getaway vessels as they were much faster than most civilian ships. With Senator Amidala at the helm of one of these vessels, even the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] had difficulty keeping pace.

On the eve of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Amidala returned to Naboo in secret, escorted by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker was compelled to leave Naboo to return to his home planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and Padmé joined him, both traveling in a Naboo Yacht. Following [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his mother's]] death and his retaliation against the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] received a distress signal from [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

Amidala and Skywalker traveled in the yacht to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in a failed attempt to rescue Kenobi. It was on Geonosis that the opening battle of the Clone Wars was fought, plunging the Galaxy into three years of warfare.

The yachts continued to serve Amidala during the early years of the Clone Wars, transporting her to such places as [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. Captain [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and the Senator journeyed there to rescue two Jedi from the crystal temple and prevent a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] conspiracy at the [[Ambush on Ilum]].

[[File:PadmeAmidalasHtypeNubianYachtMalevolence-DestroyMalevolence.png|thumb|left|220px|Padmé Amidala's yacht captured in [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence's'']] tractor beam.]]
After going to see [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] to try to reopen communication with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], Amidala was captured by Ziro to sell to [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. Amidala tricked a battle droid into answering a call on her comlink from [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. She informed C-3PO of her capture and told him to get help. C-3PO arrived at [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|Ziro's Palace]] in the Royal Yacht with members of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] to free the senator.

Several of Senator Amidala's H-type yachts suffered misfortunes. After being led into a trap near the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the Senator and the [[Padmé Amidala's H-type Nubian yacht (Malevolence)/Legends|yacht]] she was traveling in were captured by the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. In an attempt to stop [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]], Padmé set the engines to overload. The ship exploded, although Grievous escaped unscathed.

The senator used another [[Padmé Amidala's H-type Nubian yacht (Rodia)/Legends|H-type yacht]] to travel to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to assist in a food crisis on the planet. Padmé was captured by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces when [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] yielded to the Separatist's terms. While the yacht was parked, however, it was destroyed by [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] when he clumsily activated a magnetic loading arm above the craft, causing it to smash through the ship to the floor of the landing bay.

Padmé and Jar Jar later traveled to Naboo, again using an H-type yacht to investigate the presence of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on her homeworld, which led to the discovery of the recreation of the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]].

Along with this ship, Amidala would also use a [[J-type star skiff]].
